race.comment: OLUFSEN (4) settled back off the pace then let down impressively to just miss out last time over 1000m at Tamworth. Will appreciate the extra 200m today but is yet to prove himself in wet going which is the only reserve. ORSUM (8) led an open company field over this distance at Coonamble recently but was found wanting late in the piece. Very good wet tracker who drops in grade today. Sure to give a great sight. HE'S MY WARRIOR (2) has been freshened up since leading until the shadow of the post over today's trip at Tamworth 32 days ago. Placed six times on soft tracks. Each-way proposition. PANTA RHEI (5) is in the mix based on her tidy win over today's journey at Scone two runs back. Forget the last run over 1000m which was too short. Wet tracker WANDA RIVER (3) can improve back to his pet distance this afternoon.
